title: Heavenly Secrets Manifest
next_chapter_hook: As the warmth of the ancient characters lingered, Chen Ji discovered an unfilled blank at the end of the contract—a space where another name should have been inscribed.

text.content: Night hung like ink, the cold wind carrying the damp, rotting leaf scent unique to the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji sat cross-legged on the stone platform of the Forbidden Grounds ruins, a subtle golden crack at his brow center slowly widening—that was the precursor to the fourth page of the Tianji Record about to unseal. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered on the first page, his aged voice carrying a weight of solemnity never heard before: 'Open it. You will see what you never wished to face.'

dialogue.content: 'From never wishing to face? Mo Xiansheng, how many holes have you dug into me already?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not wait for an answer. He pressed both palms against the golden crack at his brow center, silently reciting the incantation from the fragmented page. In an instant, a scorching heat like magma exploded from his brow center, and the world before his eyes suddenly collapsed into endless darkness—and in the depths of that darkness, an ancient page gleaming with bronze color slowly emerged, covered with symbols older than any existing script.

dialogue.content: Those symbols... they were not written—they were carved into your very blood and bone. From the moment the first Chen ancestor formed a contract with the Tianji Record, every character was fused into your bloodline.

text.content: The text on the bronze page began to flow, rearranging itself like living creatures. Gradually, those ancient symbols transformed into characters Chen Ji could comprehend—the first line read: 'Executer's Contract · General Principles'. Immediately following, a chilling passage fully revealed: 'The Tianji Record selects through bloodline, the Executer acts on behalf of Heavenly Dao. Bloodline succession, destiny cycles; one bloodline severed, the contract ends.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Bloodline succession, destiny cycles—what did this mean? It meant that from the moment of his birth, he was the natural vessel of this contract, unable to refuse, unable to escape. And the words 'one bloodline severed, the contract ends' hung over his head like a drawn sword.

dialogue.content: So Mo Xiansheng... Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' was not coincidence, was it?

The Holy Sect knew this truth even before you did. The lock key does not lock heavenly fate—it locks the continuation of the contract. As long as Chen Nian lives, your bloodline will not be severed—and as long as the bloodline persists, the contract can never be dissolved. You think you're using the Tianji Record? No, it is using you.

text.content: Chen Ji猛地抬头，眸中掠过一抹刺骨的寒意。他的手指在石台上重重一叩，关节处因用力而泛白。took note of this。圣宗、夜清背后那只手、凌渊……全都有份。每一笔账，他都记得清清楚楚。

The bronze page continued to reveal more contract terms. 'The Executer's Responsibility: The prophecies shown by the Tianji Record must be fulfilled by the Executer with utmost effort; if a prophecy fails, the Executer's Heavenly Fate Value shall be deducted at double the difference until Heavenly Fate reaches zero and the physical body perishes.' Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure strangling his throat—every prophecy was a shackle, and every use of his ability was tightening this chain.

dialogue.content: A will spanning countless ages awakened within the depths of the Tianji Record, its voice devoid of any emotion, as if stating the most fundamental law: The contract is Heavenly Dao. Those who accept are sheltered by it, yet also bound by it. You think the Tianji Record chose you? No, the rules chose your Chen family, and you are merely the chess piece selected for this generation.

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. A chess piece? He silently repeated these two words in his heart, coldness seeping into his marrow. Fine, if I'm a chess piece, then I'll be one that bites back. A gentleman who watches a chess game without speaking is no gentleman, and a great man who sets a piece never regrets it—since he had already come this far, he had no intention of turning back.

choice.prompt: The will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye manifested in the contract, clearly declaring Chen Ji merely a chess piece of the rules. Faced with this truth that could overturn all recognition, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Accept the contract, retreat to advance
choices.description: Since refusal is impossible, might as well acceptcalmly，using the contract's rules to secretly seek flaws. As long as the green mountains remain, there will be firewood.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon resistance, endure the contract's shackles
choices.visible_reward: Gain the contract's protection, temporarily stabilize Heavenly Fate Value consumption
choices.risk_hint: May fall into deeper passivity, but can exchange for layout time

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging anger in his heart: ...Fine. Since the contract is formed, I accept. But accepting does not mean I will always bow my head.

text.content: The moment the words fell, the text on the bronze page suddenly illuminated, and a golden light pierced into Chen Ji's brow center. He felt his Heavenly Fate Value instantly drained by ten points, but at the same time, a warm force was flowing along his bloodline, as if something dormant was being awakened.

choices.text: Break the contract, bend but not break
choices.description: However heavy the shackles, there will come a day to break free. Better to be controlled by none, risking even shattering to tear open a corner of this chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly, extremely dangerous
choices.visible_reward: May trigger contract loopholes, gain unexpected liberation
choices.risk_hint: If failing, Heavenly Fate Value will be directly emptied, possibly perishing on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly erupted, his finger pointing directly at that illusory will: Stop putting on this high and mighty act! Chess pieces can also turn against the chess player—you'd better remember that!

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record trembled violently, that will seemingly startled by this unexpected defiance. After a moment, a low, cold laugh came from the void: 'Interesting. In ten thousand years, the first Executer to dare howl at me.'

choices.text: Seek loopholes, break the situation through indirect means
choices.description: Since the contract is formed, there must be gaps within. Chen Ji decided to endure first, secretly studying every detail of the contract, seeking that flaw that could move a thousand pounds with four ounces.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes大量时间 studying the contract, may miss opportunities during this period
choices.visible_reward: Discovers hidden loopholes in the contract, gains counterattack chips
choices.risk_hint: Loopholes may be deeply buried, difficult to find in short term

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sat down again, his gaze sweeping over every word of the contract like an eagle: Since I cannot change the rules, then first let me see the rules clearly. Every contract has loopholes, and I will find them.

text.content: Chen Ji's divine consciousness like dense spider silk swept inch by inch through the contract's main text. After the main text came dense annotations—regarding Heavenly Fate Value deduction rules, regarding the Executer's rights restrictions, regarding contract termination conditions. Every clause fit perfectly, yet at some细微之处 revealed a strange sense of disharmony.

Just as Chen Ji was全神贯注, his gaze suddenly froze. At the contract's end, in the place where all clauses were already filled, there was赫然留有一处空白—an unfilled blank—where the rune framework was exactly the same as other clauses,唯独 the center was empty, as if deliberately reserved but never filled.

dialogue.content: Fingertip hovering above that blank, trembling slightly: This is... the contract竟然有一处没有被填写的条款?
This place... should not exist. I thought all content was already complete, why...

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled for the first time. Chen Ji stared死死 at that blank, his mind racing—the blank clause意味着 the contract itself is incomplete; the contract incomplete意味着 there are cracks in the rules to exploit. And a clause deliberately left blank yet never filled... what should have been written there?

Chen Ji attempted to probe that blank with his divine consciousness, but an invisible force violently repelled him. He grunted in pain, his Mental Sea in agony, blood seeping from his nose onto the stone platform,触目惊心. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's will spoke again, this time带着难以察觉的... vigilance?

dialogue.content: That is not a place you should touch, Chen family descendant. The contract is sufficiently complete—at least before you have the qualification to inscribe it.

text.content: Chen Ji wiped away the nose blood, his lips反而勾起一抹弧度. Warnings often mean touching the痛处. He firmly刻入那处空白的位置 into the deepest part of his mind, then turned to look at another passage in the contract wrapped in golden symbols—'Chen family bloodline, ancient alliance, sharing heavenly secrets, sharing heavenly fate'. Sharing heavenly secrets, sharing heavenly fate... these eight characters如同一道闪电, cleaving open a long-standing谜团 in his heart.

Chen Nian. Heavenly Fate Lock Key. She was taken by the Holy Sect, seemingly as a bargaining chip against him, but if the contract explicitly states 'sharing heavenly secrets, sharing heavenly fate'... then Chen Nian's existence itself is another fulcrum of this contract. Her bloodline is of the same origin as his, her heavenly fate is linked with his—protecting her is not merely brotherly affection, but an inherent requirement of the contract itself.

From afar, the bell on Tianqing Sect Main Peak came悠悠传来—the third quarter past midnight. Chen Ji slowly closed the Tianji Record, the fourth page's content deeply imprinted in his神魂. In thirty days: the fate arbiter, that blank clause, and Chen Nian... all clues intertwined in his mind into a great net, and he stood at the center of the web.
As the warmth of the ancient characters lingered, Chen Ji discovered an unfilled blank at the end of the contract—a space where another name should have been inscribed.
